verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's own docs say it aims to be Sentry API compatible, so existing Sentry API tooling (Grafana, GitLab error tracking) can drive it. However, the pack has no first-party GlitchTip API reference, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The MCP server and CLI are separate interfaces and earn no credit as the documented public API. Missing for 10: a first-party public REST API reference, a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, documented API authentication and endpoint coverage, and independent hands-on confirmation of driving the product via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: GlitchTip aims to be Sentry API compatible. Anything that works with Sentry should also work with GlitchTip.
In Grafana, navigate to Configuration > Data sources, click "Add data source". In the search field, type "Sentry".
